plugins.name: skill-harvest
plugins.description: Looks back over a Claude Code session for work worth turning into a skill or agent, proposes the best candidates, and builds only the ones you pick.

plugins.name: pots
plugins.description: A per-project to-do list that never forgets: stored todos merged with a fresh scan of the project's files, behind an improvement-pot gate; private, or shared with your team through git; plus a ranking agent.

plugins.name: stack-it-right
plugins.description: Chooses a stack from the project's requirements and checks every candidate live (latest version, maintenance, pricing) before recommending.

plugins.name: session-open
plugins.description: A start-of-session routine: parked work, unscheduled critical todos, an ideas inbox, and slot accountability for today's calendar sessions.

plugins.name: voice-over-chain
plugins.description: Locks a voice-over's Audacity processing chain from measurements of your own test take (ffmpeg), simulates it, and checks what Audacity actually produced.

metadata.description: Workflow skills for Claude Code: skill-harvest, pots (todos + improvement backlog, solo or team), stack-it-right, session-open and voice-over-chain.
